Note on Desktop vs. Mobile

The feedback document was primarily written for the mobile version of the site. Because the website uses a responsive design system, all text changes (Title Case, alignment, testimonials, House Rules, etc.) automatically apply to both mobile and desktop simultaneously. No desktop-specific re-work was needed for text changes.
